title: 第15章 何诗韵被咬一口第16章 陈天龙苟道高手
content_zh:
兰天庭脸色铁青：“抓到妖姬，才能审出背后主使之人，没有证据，我怎能胡乱冤枉人。”
“我让妖姬过来，当着你的面说出真相，你敢杀陈天龙吗？”
“我为何不敢？”
“你就是不敢。”
兰天庭怒目圆瞪，杀气腾腾。
张扬迎视着他的目光，继续道：“你不敢，我敢。”
兰天庭瞳孔一缩，凌厉的眼神渐渐消退，换成了复杂之色。
“你不敢动陈天龙，是害怕他没有底线，伤害你的家人，我孑然一身，什么都敢干。妖姬现在是我的人，我不会让你动她，陈天龙交给我，我会让陈家在江南消失，你同意就点头，不同意以后就继续受陈天龙威胁，做名不符实的江南第一人。”
兰天庭低头沉思，没有说话。
张扬不急，静静等待。
半晌，兰天庭抬头：“陈天龙虽然没有修炼内功，但肉身修炼到了极致，一双铁手不比我差多少。”
“兰家主等我好消息。”
张扬说完，转身离去。
刚走出兰家别墅，两女迎了上来，正是何诗韵跟严冰。
“怎么样了？”何诗韵急问。
“兰天庭同意把永春堂还给你。”张扬回道。
“太好了。”
严冰目光炽热地看着他，“没想到短短一个月时间，你就变得这么厉害，仿佛换了个人似的。”
何诗韵心情复杂，她想起之前跟张扬说的话。
按张扬现在的修炼速度，自己丈夫也望尘莫及，突破宗师境界也并非不可能。

“你们先回酒店，我还有些事情要办。”
从兰天庭嘴里得到陈天龙的底细，张扬得想想，怎么解决这个家伙。
陈天龙是混黑道的，是个亡命之徒，不像兰天庭有底线。
机会只有一次，一旦不成功，他将受到无穷无尽的追杀，他身边的人也会受到牵连。
半个小时之后，张扬跟妖姬在一处秘密据点相见。
“索命死了，陈天龙肯定会怀疑，无论如何，咱们也得出手。”张扬思虑片刻，吩咐，“你去把陈天龙找出来，千万别打草惊蛇，我这两天看看能不能把小金钟符制作出来。”
妖姬点了点头，领命而去。
下午，何诗韵打电话过来，说兰家归还了永春堂。
张扬回到永春堂，一群人正在庆祝。
“张扬，对不起，是我错怪你了。”
老中医吴永军上前道歉，脸色尴尬。
张扬懒得理他，若不是对方有技术，还有一批客户，他早就让何诗韵将他轰走了。
何诗韵安排了晚上加餐，就在店里。
由于太开心，何诗韵喝不少酒，连敬张扬几杯。
严冰作为保镖，从不喝酒，要负责主人安全。
餐后，何诗韵有些微醺，在严冰耳边说了几句悄悄话。
严冰偷偷看了张扬一眼，脸色顿时就红了起来，什么都没说。
回房之后，张扬收到严冰短信，对方邀请他去武堂练武。
练武是假，别的目的才是真的，张扬以没空为由拒绝了。
content_en:
Lan Tianting's face turned livid: "Only by catching the Enchantress can we find out the person behind it. Without evidence, how can I accuse people randomly and unjustly?"
"I asked Enchantress to come over and tell the truth in front of you. Do you dare to kill Chen Tianlong?"
"Why don't I dare?"
"You just don't dare."
Lan Tianting's eyes were filled with anger and murderous intent.
Zhang Yang met his gaze and continued: "You don't dare, I dare."
Lan Tianting's pupils shrank, and his sharp eyes gradually faded away, replaced by complex expressions.
"You dare not touch Chen Tianlong because you are afraid that he will have no bottom line and hurt your family. I am alone and dare to do anything. Enchantress is mine now, and I will not let you touch her. Leave Chen Tianlong to me, and I will make the Chen family disappear in Jiangnan. If you agree, just nod. If you don't agree, you will continue to be threatened by Chen Tianlong and become the number one person in Jiangnan who does not live up to his name."
Lan Tianting lowered his head in thought and said nothing.
Don't rush Zhang Yang, just wait quietly.
After a while, Lan Tianting raised his head and said: "Although Chen Tianlong has not practiced internal strength, his physical body has been cultivated to the extreme. His iron hands are not much worse than mine."
"Master Lan is waiting for good news from me."
After Zhang Yang finished speaking, he turned and left.
As soon as they walked out of the Lan family villa, they were greeted by two women, He Shiyun and Yan Bing.
"How's it going?" He Shiyun asked anxiously.
"Lan Tianting agrees to return Yongchun Hall to you." Zhang Yang replied.
"Great."
Yan Bing looked at him with burning eyes, "I didn't expect that in just one month, you would become so powerful, as if you were a different person."
He Shiyun was in a complicated mood, and she remembered what she had said to Zhang Yang before.
According to Zhang Yang's current cultivation speed, his husband is far behind, so it is not impossible to break through to the master level.
"You guys go back to the hotel first, I have some things to do."
After getting the details about Chen Tianlong from Lan Tianting, Zhang Yang had to think about how to deal with this guy.
Chen Tianlong is a gangster and a desperado, unlike Lan Tianting who has a bottom line.
There is only one chance. If he fails, he will be hunted endlessly, and the people around him will also be implicated.
Half an hour later, Zhang Yang and Enchantress met at a secret stronghold.
"Chen Tianlong will definitely be suspicious of Suo Ming. No matter what, we have to take action." Zhang Yang thought for a moment and then ordered, "Go and find Chen Tianlong. Don't scare the snake. I'll see if I can make the little golden bell talisman in the next two days."
The Enchantress nodded and followed the order.
In the afternoon, He Shiyun called and said that the Lan family had returned Yongchun Hall.
Zhang Yang returned to Yongchun Hall, where a group of people were celebrating.
"Zhang Yang, I'm sorry, I wrongly blamed you."
Wu Yongjun, an old Chinese medicine doctor, stepped forward to apologize, looking embarrassed.
Zhang Yang was too lazy to pay attention to him. If the other party didn't have skills and a group of customers, he would have let He Shiyun drive him away.
He Shiyun arranged for extra food in the evening, which was in the store.
Because he was so happy, He Shiyun drank a lot of wine and even drank several glasses of wine.
As a bodyguard, Yan Bing never drinks and is responsible for the safety of his master.
After the meal, He Shiyun was a little tipsy and whispered a few words in Yan Bing's ear.
Yan Bing glanced at Zhang Yang secretly, his face immediately turned red, and he didn't say anything.
After returning to his room, Zhang Yang received a text message from Yan Bing, inviting him to practice martial arts at the martial arts hall.
Martial arts training was fake, but other purposes were real. Zhang Yang refused because he had no time.
